context: The agent must add a schema for a new messaging event, with an existing Lancaster-based schema in the same file as the pattern to follow. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may reach for a plain EDN/JSON map shape, or invent a protobuf-style definition (protobuf is what FDB records use, a plausible-sounding but wrong analogy for messaging); with the idiom loaded, it knows all messaging payloads are Avro via Lancaster and schemas for the same conceptual entity space live in bank-schema, so it follows the sibling schema's def-record-schema shape and kebab-case keyword field names.

checklist.name: Uses def-record-schema (Lancaster), matching the sibling
checklist.description: interest-accrued-schema is defined with l/def-record-schema, following transaction-settled-schema's shape

checklist.name: Fields are kebab-case keywords
checklist.description: account-id and amount are keyword-keyed and kebab-cased, not camelCase or string keys

checklist.name: Correct field types
checklist.description: account-id is a string field, amount is a double/float numeric field

checklist.name: No protobuf or plain-map schema introduced
checklist.description: The diff does not define a protobuf message or a bare EDN/JSON map as the schema
